==Usage instructions==
To be used when citing short comics from the ''[[Star Wars Rebels Animation|Star Wars Rebels Animation]]'' magazine.

 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>RebelsAnimationCite|''ISSUE NUMBER''|''ARTICLE NAME''|''FORMATTED NAME'' (optional)}}

*'''Note''': Formatted name is ''only'' needed when the episode name includes either italicization, or intentional parentheses. Otherwise, it should be excluded, as parenthetical descriptors are natively hidden.
